terminals.name: vite-dev
terminals.description: Vite dev server for the Samkraft frontend, served on http://localhost:5173. Add VITE_SUPABASE_URL, VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, and VITE_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY as secrets to connect a real Supabase backend; without them the app boots against .env.example placeholders.
